column1: # Durgā Saptaśatī: collation of the transcription (1917 Nirṇaya Sāgara print) with the
# Gita Press edition (Śrīdurgāsaptaśatī, sthūlākṣara mūla, Gorakhpur, 1994 printing;
# a modern copyrighted edition, used only to check readings; its text is not copied.
# Spelling conventions are not collated (anusvāra for a class nasal, avagraha).
# file  mantra(1917)  ours  gitapress  verdict  [gp page]
#   verdict: slip = our misreading, 1917 agrees with Gita Press (corrected);
#            variant = 1917 differs from Gita Press (kept, listed)

column3: ततो देवा ददुस्तस्यै स्वानि स्वान्यायुधानि च (half-verse)
column4: absent; footnote: some MSS add it with ऊचुर्जयजयेत्युच्चैर्जयन्तीं ते जयैषिणः
Gita Press divides these verses half a verse earlier and adds कबन्धा युयुधुर्देव्या गृहीतपरमायुधाः (its 63), balancing the half it omits at 20
Gita Press divides 34–37 half a verse differently (its 34 is the half भगवत्या कृतं सर्वं…); the count of 42 is the same

column3: या देवी … नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः (whole line each mantra, as 1917 prints it)
column4: the line once, then नमस्तस्यै ॥१४॥ नमस्तस्यै ॥१५॥ नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥१६॥

column3: मौर्वाः (corrected from our मौर्याः, misread; 1917 prints मौर्वाः)

column4: Gita Press makes 57–62 full verses half a verse later and 63 (तेषां मातृगणो…) the half; 1917 makes 57 (मुखेन काली…) the half. Count 63 the same

Gita Press lacks अश्वांश्च पातयामास रथं सारथिना सह (18; footnote: some MSS add it) and so divides 18–23 half a verse differently; it adds the half जज्वलुश्चाग्नयः शान्ताः शान्ता दिग्जनितस्वनाः as its 32, which 1917 does not print. Count 32 the same
Gita Press makes 49–54 full verses half a verse later and 55 (तदा तदावतीर्याहं…) the half; 1917 makes 49 (शाकंभरीति…) the half. Count 55 the same

Gita Press makes 20 (सर्वं ममैतन्माहात्म्यं…) and 35 (जगद्विध्वंसिनि…) full verses and has its halves at 30 (दूरादेव पलायन्ते…) and 32 (इत्युक्त्वा सा भगवती…); 1917 has them at 20 and 35. Count 41 the same
